Stair lift cost guide · Michigan

How Much Does a Straight Stair Lift Cost in Michigan?

The short answer: most straight stair lifts in Michigan cost between $3,000 and $5,500 fully installed [CONFIRM]. With Senior Home Solutions, straight stair lifts start at $X,XXX, and that price includes the lift, the rail, installation and a demonstration.

Below is what goes into that number, what can raise or lower it, and how to avoid paying for more lift than your staircase needs.

Get My Exact Price

At a glance

Stair Lift Prices at a Glance

Straight, no turns

One straight stair lift

$3,000 – $5,500 [CONFIRM]

Timeline: days. About 2–4 hours on site.

Straight flights with a flat landing

Two straight stair lifts

$6,000 – $11,000 [CONFIRM]

Timeline: days.

Curved, spiral or pie-shaped steps

Custom curved stair lift

$8,000 – $15,000+ [CONFIRM]

Timeline: 2–4 weeks to build the rail.

Ranges are typical for Michigan and are not a quote. Your price depends on your staircase and the lift you choose.

What Affects the Cost of a Straight Stair Lift?

Length of the staircase

A longer flight needs a longer rail. Most homes fall inside standard lengths.

Weight capacity

Standard models suit most riders. Heavy-duty models cost more.

Seat and comfort options

Powered swivel seats, powered footrests and upgraded upholstery add to the price.

Obstructions at the bottom

If a doorway sits at the foot of the stairs, a folding rail keeps the walkway clear and adds cost.

Indoor or outdoor

Outdoor lifts are weather-sealed and priced higher.

New or pre-owned

Why a Straight Lift Costs Far Less Than a Curved One

The chair and motor are much the same on both. The difference is the rail.

A straight rail comes in standard lengths and is cut to fit your stairs on the day. A curved rail has to be measured, drawn and fabricated for one staircase only. That custom work is why a curved lift can cost around three times as much and take weeks to arrive.

Straight rail: standard, cut to fit, installed in hours

Curved rail: custom-built, 2–4 weeks, much higher cost

Our advice: use a straight lift whenever the staircase allows it

Stairs with a landing

Two Straight Stair Lifts vs. One Curved Lift

If your stairs have a flat landing between two straight flights, you have a choice. One custom curved lift can ride around the turn. Or two straight lifts can cover each flight, with a short walk or transfer across the landing.

For families where the rider can manage a few steps across the landing, two straight lifts can save $3,000 to $7,000 compared with a curved lift, and can be installed in days instead of weeks.
